affected_subject.reason: Identifies Book._updateLimitPostOrder and the price-level doubly linked list it maintains.

trigger_or_action.reason: Appending a new order writes back-link to memory copy; cancelling/matching a non-head order triggers the faulty removal.

direct_effect.reason: prevOrderId==0 causes head to move past real head, orphaning orders, desyncing counters, and flipping best bid/ask to MAX_UINT sentinel.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Explicit invariant: every order addressable via headOrder/tailOrder chain and open-interest counters reflect reachable orders only.

summary: Report identifies the affected function, the append/removal trigger, concrete corruption effects, and an explicit reachability/counter invariant, sufficient to attempt P/I/V formalization.
